title: Senior Installation Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

title: Analista de Dados II
description:

Somos um hub de serviços e produtos financeiros escaláveis.

Somos a fintech do Grupo Energisa, que há 120 anos leva energia de qualidade a milhões de brasileiros, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do país. Criamos produtos que aceleram a inclusão digital e financeira de clientes de todo o Brasil.

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • SQL intermediário a avançado (preferencialmente em BigQuery, mas experiência em outros bancos é aceita).

Conhecimento desejáveis (não obrigatórios, mas diferenciais):

  • Programação em Python ou R para análises e automações.
  • Noções de Machine Learning, modelagem estatística ou técnicas de predição.
  • Experiência prévia com pipelines de dados ou ferramentas de orquestração.

title: Security Operations Center Manager
description:
Gerente de SOC (Security Operations Center Manager)

Modelo híbrido | Local : Escritório no Centro do Rio de Janeiro

Sobre a Empresa

Nosso cliente é um provedor de serviços gerenciados de infraestrutura e cibersegurança , com forte atuação em operações críticas de TI , suportando ambientes corporativos, industriais (OT) e em nuvem. A empresa está em expansão e busca um(a) Gerente de SOC para liderar a evolução de seu Centro de Operações de Segurança.

Desafio da Posição

Você será responsável por liderar, estruturar e evoluir o SOC , garantindo excelência em detecção, análise, resposta e contenção de incidentes de segurança. Fará a gestão de uma operação 24x7, com times multidisciplinares (Blue Team, Threat Hunting, CTI, DFIR) e ambientes complexos (TI + OT + Cloud).

É uma posição estratégica, com alto impacto e interface direta com o CISO e clientes.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a operação do SOC 24x7 e garantir SLAs, KPIs, MTTD/MTTR.
  • Gerenciar equipes de analistas, engenheiros e especialistas (Threat Hunting, CTI, DFIR).
  • Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes críticos.
  • Conduzir investigações avançadas, resposta a incidentes e exercícios de resiliência (tabletop, Purple Team).
  • Evoluir regras de detecção, automações e integrações de SIEM/SOAR/EDR/XDR/NDR.
  • Garantir visibilidade e monitoramento em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e OT.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos, métricas e análises baseadas em frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e ISO 27001.
  • Atuar junto a fornecedores, clientes e áreas internas como NOC, Engenharia e GRC.
  • Apoiar times comerciais em pré-vendas técnicas de cibersegurança.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida liderando SOCs, operações 24x7 e Blue Team.
  • Vivência com SIEM (Elastic, QRadar, Sentinel, Splunk) e SOAR.
  • Forte domínio de EDR/XDR, NDR, IDS/IPS e firewalls.
  • Experiência em Resposta a Incidentes e DFIR.
  • Conhecimento de ambientes Windows, Linux, Active Directory e hardening.
  • Experiência com Cloud Security (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Entendimento de ambientes OT/ICS e Purdue Model.
  • Experiência com scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em Threat Hunting avançado, CTI, detecção comportamental.
  • Atuação em setores regulados (financeiro, energia, saúde, manufatura).
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, CEH, GICSP.
  • Certificações cloud (AWS Security, Azure AZ-500, Google PCSE).
  • Conhecimentos em Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, CNAPP.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

Our promise to you:

-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry

What we ask of you:

-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.

Who we are:

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

About the job:

The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.

Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Especialista de Controladoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na controladoria societária com foco em normas contábeis nacionais e internacionais, assegurando a correta consolidação das demonstrações financeiras, conformidade regulatória e suporte técnico às auditorias externas e internas.

  • Garantir a correta aplicação das normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS) nas demonstrações financeiras consolidadas;
  • Elaborar, revisar e validar balanços patrimoniais, DRE, DFC e notas explicativas;
  • Realizar consolidação contábil de empresas do grupo, incluindo transações intercompany e ajustes de equivalência patrimonial;
  • Apoiar processos de reestruturação societária, fusões, cisões e incorporações;
  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto às auditorias externas e internas, fornecendo suporte e documentação;
  • Realizar análises críticas de contas contábeis, conciliações e validações de saldos;
  • Participar de projetos de melhoria de processos contábeis, automação e compliance;
  • Interagir com áreas como jurídico, fiscal, planejamento e tesouraria para alinhamento de informações societárias;
  • Monitorar atualizações regulatórias e propor ajustes nos processos contábeis conforme necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação completa em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo;
  • Especialização (desejável): Pós-graduação ou MBA em Controladoria, Contabilidade ou Finanças;
  • Experiência sólida em controladoria societária, consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Experiência em empresas de auditoria (Big4) será considerado um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento avançado em normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC) e internacionais (IFRS);

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.

Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy , gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em OpenShift ).

Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C# .NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).

Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis):

Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).

Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente OpenShift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.

Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

This role requires a minimum of three days per week on-site in our Rio de Janeiro office.

We are seeking a Junior Recruitment Analyst to deliver "white glove," concierge-level recruitment service for our esteemed pharmaceutical client, focusing on the Brazilian market. This role demands an individual who is polished in nature , process-driven, and possesses a strong service mindset with superior communication skills and a keen attention to detail.

You are responsible for proactively reviewing candidates to determine if they meet the rigorous requirements and job experience for complex pharmaceutical profiles, ensuring a premium, seamless, and elevated experience for all candidates and stakeholders.

The core function of this role is to manage full-cycle recruitment with the meticulous discipline required for complex industry profiles (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Aviation).

  • Candidate and Hiring Manager Engagement: Cultivate strong relationships, acting as a professional concierge to ensure an elevated experience throughout the process.

  • Collaborate on special projects to enhance recruitment strategy and operations.

✅ What You Need To Bring

Successful candidates are defined by their stability, communication, and process-driven approach.

  • Experience: A minimum of 1+ year in a role directly supporting recruiting functions and demonstrated full-cycle recruiting experience for at least one year.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled to obtain one.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills that reflect a polished in nature professionalism.
  • Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus.
  • Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
  • Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.

✨ What’s In It For You

  • Join a global market leader in HR services with industry recognition.
  • Join a diverse and inclusive workplace.
  • Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities.
  • Join a company that offers a great work/life balance.

É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.

  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.
  • Vivência com marcas B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile.
  • Noções de motion design (Lottie, microinterações, GSAP ou similar).
  • Noções de A/B testing , CRO e métricas de funil.
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .

  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


Como se destacar:

Envie portfólio com projetos em Webflow (links públicos ou clonables), mostrando:

  • antes/depois, raciocínio de UX e decisões de layout;
  • exemplos de coleções dinâmicas, componentes reutilizáveis e interações;
  • casos em que você integrou Webflow com outras ferramentas (CRM, automações, forms, etc.);

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.


In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.

  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).

Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;

  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

  • Domínio avançado de Python (incluindo bibliotecas de dados e machine learning ) e proficiência em SQL para construção de queries complexas e integração com bancos de dados relacionais e data lakes .
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e MLOps (Git, Docker, Kubernetes, automação de pipelines, CI/CD) e integração com ambientes cloud (AWS/GCP).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em estatística, matemática aplicada e técnicas de modelagem, incluindo validação, tuning e explicabilidade de modelos.

  • Diferenciais: experiência com IA generativa aplicada a negócios, projetos de transformação digital, ambientes regulados e arquiteturas modernas de dados (Data Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks).

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Depois de anos construindo uma carreira exponencial e mentorando centenas de profissionais e líderes, entendi que a grande transformação acontece quando quem está à frente da empresa evolui. É o líder e o empresário crescendo. É o negócio ganhando direção, consistência e velocidade.

A vaga anunciada faz parte dessa expansão. Buscamos pessoas que entendem que crescimento é responsabilidade diária e que estão dispostas a entregar o seu melhor todos os dias, porque aqui, performance não é discurso: é prática.


Busco pessoas com mentalidade empreendedora, visão de longo prazo e que estejam abertas a aprender com uma jornada de crescimento e desenvolvimento significativo.

Estamos crescendo rápido e buscamos um(a) vendedor(a) de alta performance para conduzir as negociações e fechar parcerias com profissionais e empresas que buscam aceleração, liderança e crescimento.

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis, com foco em integração, transformação e governança de dados na plataforma Snowflake.

Projetar e implementar soluções de ingestão e orquestração utilizando Azure Data Factory, Databricks e outras ferramentas do ecossistema Azure.

Integrar dados de diferentes fontes (REST, SOAP, OData APIs), garantindo a qualidade, consistência e performance dos processos.

Modelar dados corporativos com boas práticas de modelagem relacional (E/R, normalização, chaves primárias e estrangeiras).

Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos e engenheiros de dados para desenhar soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta disponibilidade.

Administrar e versionar código por meio do GitHub e CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), aplicando automação e boas práticas de deploy.

Gerenciar componentes da infraestrutura Azure, como Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, Logic Apps e Azure Functions.

Monitorar performance, custos e qualidade dos pipelines, aplicando tunning e melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Colaborar com times globais em ambiente ágil, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


O que você precisa ter

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Data Engineer, com atuação prática em desenvolvimento de pipelines e soluções de dados em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Azure Data Factory, Snowflake e Databricks, com experiência em integração, transformação e governança de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL, incluindo transformação, otimização e performance tuning.
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados e manipulação de dados semiestruturados (JSON, XML, Parquet).
  • Vivência com CI/CD, GitHub Actions e práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Sólida compreensão da infraestrutura Azure (Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, monitoramento, Azure Functions).
  • Experiência com orquestração e agendamento de jobs (ADF triggers, Logic Apps, FiveTran).
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente internacional.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com estratégias de governança e segurança de dados (GDPR, criptografia, controle de acesso).
  • Vivência com monitoramento de qualidade de dados e frameworks de controle.
  • Conhecimento em otimização de custos e performance em ambientes cloud.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e atuação em times multifuncionais.
  • Capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e habilidade para propor soluções sustentáveis e eficientes.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Jira, Confluence

title: Culinary Instructor
description:
Key Responsibilities :

1 Culinary Training & Development :

◦ Develop and execute the ship’s overall Culinary Training & Development strategy for all Culinary crew members with 2 or fewer stripes.

◦ Conduct relevant training and follow-up audits to ensure these standards are being met consistently.

description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness

title: Salesforce Developer OmniStudio

Join Our Team:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in OmniStudio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing OmniStudio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!

  • Develop solutions using Omni Studio tools such as OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards to build dynamic, customer-centric applications.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical designs.
  • Create technical specifications and designs for Omni Studio components that align with project objectives and Salesforce best practices.
  • Customize and configure the Salesforce platform using declarative tools to meet business needs, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce technologies as needed.
  • Implement integrations with third-party systems using Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to ensure the quality and functionality of the solutions.
  • Manage the deployment process using tools like Salesforce DX, change sets, or version control systems, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments.
  • Create detailed documentation for developed solutions, including design documents, user guides, and maintenance instructions.
  • Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions, addressing any issues that arise in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of Omni Studio solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently within Salesforce governor limits.
  • Work closely with project managers, other developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand their evolving needs, and make recommendations for enhancements or new features.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with the team, contributing to the collective expertise and professional development of colleagues.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Salesforce releases, Omni Studio updates, and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
  • Ensure that all development work complies with company policies, industry standards, and Salesforce security guidelines.


Requirements:

title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.
