Resumo: Garantir a gestão eficiente do pool de ferramentas (Tooling) da divisão SSR, assegurando disponibilidade, confiabilidade e conformidade técnica para atender às demandas operacionais e de projetos, com foco em segurança, qualidade e custo.


Responsabilidades e atividades principais:


·Gerenciar o pool de ferramentas SSR (SSR Tool Pool), garantindo rastreabilidade e disponibilidade.

·Elaborar orçamentos para reparo e manutenção de equipamentos (Tooling).

·Planejar etapas de trabalho em conjunto com a gerência para mobilização e desmobilização de equipamentos.

·Inserir e diligenciar demandas de manutenção preventiva e corretiva junto ao Workshop e Planejamento.

·Controlar estoque de peças sobressalentes e componentes críticos para evitar paradas.

·Atuar como ponto focal para Operações e Projetos em demandas relacionadas a Tooling.

·Interface com o time comercial na elaboração de CTR (Cost Time Resources) e atendimento de novas oportunidades.

·Manter contato comercial interno e externo com fornecedores de serviços, peças e componentes.

·Garantir clareza nas negociações e comunicação técnica entre gerência e partes contratadas.

·Coordenar técnicos na execução de tarefas mecânicas, hidráulicas e eletrônicas de baixa complexidade.

·Coordenar técnicos para atendimento de demandas Offshore.

·Coordenar técnicos para movimentações de recebimento e saída de assets.

·Supervisionar testes funcionais e reparos complexos em atuadores, motores, cilindros, bombas, válvulas e ferramentas especiais.

·Realizar suporte técnico offshore quando necessário.

·Realizar tracking completo de todas as ferramentas do pool SSR.

·Revisar relatórios internos de manutenção, incluindo custos envolvidos.

·Certificar-se do perfeito funcionamento dos equipamentos após reparos e testes.

·Realizar visitas técnicas de inspeção em fornecedores para garantir conformidade com normas.

·Monitorar KPIs como tempo de reparo, disponibilidade de ferramentas e custo por manutenção.

·Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança e regulamentos internos.

·Utilizar sistemas ERP (People Soft Brasil) para registro e rastreabilidade das ordens de serviço.

·Utilizar sistema URSA para gestão Geral das Ferramentas.


Requisitos Mínimos:

· Ensino Superior em Engenharias e/ou áreas afins.

· Desejável Inglês Avançado.

· Boa Habilidade com Excel, Pacote Office, MSProject e PowerBI.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are?

Softensity is a US-based IT outsourcing company with global software teams. We are headquartered in Atlanta, GA, USA with development teams in LATAM, Eastern Europe and Türkiye. When you have better teams, you build better software. Let’s do this together!


We are currently seeking a dynamic and inquisitive Senior Software Engineer with strong technical skills and the ability to navigate organizational dynamics, with of adaptability and foundational knowledge in security applications


The Project:

Our client’s platform runs on the Microsoft Azure cloud and follows a microservices architecture. They run a mix of open source, vendor-licensed, and internally developed tools to perform functions such as provisioning, software deployment, logging, and monitoring.

You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. The team is collaborative; they work closely with the development teams and support to deliver the best results for the organization. The goal is to balance the best solution with the need to get things done for each engineering challenge we face.


Technical Skills:

Must have

  • Proficiency in .NET Core
  • Proficiency in Cloud (ideally Azure , but AWS or GCP are acceptable)
  • Strong background in Microservices architecture
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep , ARM templates , Terraform , or Pulumi
  • Experience with Event Hubs , Service Bus , or similar
  • Knowledge of Container Apps , Function Apps , App Services
  • Experience with Storage Accounts , CDN , Subscriptions , Resource Groups
  • Understanding of App Insights , Log Analytics
  • Experience managing RBAC , Managed Identities , SPNs , App Registrations
  • Hands-on experience with Docker
  • Database skills with Azure SQL, MongoDB, SQL, and Cosmos DB

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tools
  • Familiarity with cloud automation , especially infrastructure automation
  • Comfortable exploring Infrastructure as Code (IaC) , Developer Experience (DX) , UI , and architecture as necessary
  • Familiarity with widely used Azure resources , including ASB/Event Hub , AKS/ACA , Storage Account


Why Join Us?

We are passionate about top quality talent and giving our team members the tools they need for them to keep on growing and learning. The sky is truly the limit and we want you to feel challenged and motivated in every single project that you're a part of all while working with cutting edge technologies and amazing clients.


What to expect?

  • Coursera credentials
  • Remote work
  • Learning opportunities


Softensity is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to gender, identity, or personal background.

title: Engenheiro de dados GCP
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados. Este profissional terá papel fundamental no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de integração de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e seguras. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, práticas modernas de engenharia de dados e perfil analítico para garantir o fluxo eficiente de dados na organização.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL/ELT para ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Implementar frameworks de ingestão de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, streaming etc.).

Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados por meio de validação, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados, Analistas e áreas de negócio para fornecer datasets limpos, confiáveis e bem documentados.

Trabalhar com serviços nativos de nuvem (ex.: BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Databricks, Snowflake) para implementar arquiteturas escaláveis.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI/CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex.: PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Qualificações Necessárias

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Cloud Composer, Prefect, Dagster).

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD, Terraform ou similares).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Competências Comportamentais

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

Trabalho em equipe, postura proativa e colaborativa.

Inglês fluente (escrito e falado);

espanhol será considerado um diferencial.

description:

Diferenciais:

Complete higher education in Computer Engineering or related areas.

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (AWS) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. Required Skills & Experience

  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)

  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

description:

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Senior Data Science Analyst para se juntar ao nosso time de Data Plataform.

O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de machine learning utilizando técnicas de classificação, regressão e clusterização;
  • Realizar testes de modelos de machine learning, incluindo, mas não se limitando a, testes A/B, testes de hipótese e validação cruzada;
  • Proficiente em feature engineering para otimizar os desempenhos dos modelos desenvolvidos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning em cima da plataforma databricks;
  • Manutenção de modelos existentes (Acompanhamento e eventuais retreinamentos) ;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias de dados para identificar padrões e tendências relevantes;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de práticas de MLOps..

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Machine Learning | Regressão, Classificação, Clusterização, Redes Neurais, Seleção de Features, Cross-Validation, "Curse of Dimensionality", Viés-Variânica, Explicabilidade de Modelos, etc;
  • Estatística Avançada | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, desing experimental, modelagem preditiva, otimização, testes de hipótese, regressão, modelagem e métodos;
  • Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar scrips e queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;
  • Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;
  • Modelagem Estatística & Advanced Analytics | NLP, Séries Temporais, Random Forests, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Clustering methods (e.g. K-means), Classification methods (Decision Trees/Random Forest), among others;
  • MLOps básico | para entender os desafios de se colocar um modelo em produção;
  • Experimentação | Testes A|B, Hipóteses, Modelos de Atribuição;
  • Grandes Volumes | Extrair e manipular grandes bases de dados, utilizando a stack de dados disponível.


FERRAMENTAS

  • SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;
  • Python ou R | Pra quando a coisa fica bem séria;
  • Scala, Java & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;
  • Teste de Hipóteses | Para suportar o processo de tomada de decisão e criar informação de suporte;
  • Databricks | Uso de clusters e workspaces para BigData.


O que oferecemos

  • Realizar testes unitários, de integração e UI para garantir estabilidade e alta performance;
  • Ser referência técnica no time mobile, apoiando e orientando outros desenvolvedores.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Proficiência comprovada em Flutter/Dart.
  • Domínio do ciclo de vida de aplicativos mobile (iOS e Android) e dos processos de build e deploy (App Store e Google Play).
  • Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de software , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de código.
  • Experiência em injeção de dependência (DI) e inversão de controle (IoC).
  • Integração com APIs RESTful e manipulação de dados (JSON).
  • Habilidade com testes unitários e de integração.
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git e fluxo Git Flow.
  • Capacidade de liderança técnica, comunicação clara e colaboração com stakeholders.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com testes de UI e automação.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento (Sentry, Firebase Performance, Crashlytics).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo (Kotlin/Swift) e comunicação via Platform Channels.
  • Publicação e manutenção de aplicativos nas lojas oficiais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com CI/CD e automação de builds.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);

  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Tech Lead Flutter e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na posição.

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos.   • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.

Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

title: Manager, Corporate Development

Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.


Your Purpose

As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it's about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.


Reports To

Head of Sales


Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.


What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP (Unique Selling Proposition) to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.


Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Want to leave an undoubtedly legacy with us? Fasten your seatbelt and join this spaceship, where you will find exponential growth and the opportunity to thrive!

Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

• Prescribe relevant learning based on scope and workload (such as certifications, solutions, products,

etc.)

• Build custom partner learning plans, where required, based on the results of scoping/needs analysis and business priority.

• Monitor learner progress and detect any issues.

• Create and present Quarterly/Monthly Business Reviews with senior L&D/Business/Technology

stakeholders

• Monitor and analyze learning stats for data-driven decisions.

• Explore business problems and create different solution models.

• Make recommendations for improvement and present to partners and internal stakeholders.

• Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Qualifications/Requirements

We are looking for individuals with the following qualifications, skills, and experiences:

• 5+ years relevant experience being an L&D consultant or in any business facing consultant role driving outcomes.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and Computer Science, or a related field (required)

• Masters candidates (preferred)

• Cloud Digital Leader or Generative AI Leader (GAIL) certifications, preferred but not mandatory

• Experience in the channel partner ecosystem highly preferred


All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.

Some travel involved within Brazil to client and partner locations.


Zensar encourages our employees to seek higher education and training. However, this position will require you to be completely available during work hours.

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior
description:
Se você é apaixonado por dados e desafios analíticos, essa vaga é para você!

Profissional com sólida experiência em Visão Computacional , Machine Learning e análise estatística , atuando em todas as etapas do ciclo de dados — da coleta e transformação à modelagem e diagnóstico de performance . Domínio em Python (Pandas, Scikit-Learn, OpenCV) , SQL e Cloud AWS , com forte foco em extrair padrões ocultos, gerar insights valiosos e impulsionar decisões baseadas em dados.


Informações:

Modelo de trabalho via contrato PJ;

Home Office;


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimentos em Cloud Azure, AWS e Databricks.
  • (Foco em AWS) Conhecimentos do processo de construção de modelos.
  • Análise Descritiva e Exploratória de Dados.
  • Teste de Hipóteses Inferência Clássica e Bayesiana.
  • Construção de modelos Estatísticos de Machine Learning.
  • Análise de Diagnósticos.
  • Fortes Conhecimentos de Python/R.
  • Experiência com análise de dados para descobrir padrões ocultos.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Experiência com análise e resolução de problemas relacionados a dados.
  • Experiência com programação em Python e seu ecossistema de análise de dados (Pandas, Scikit-Learn , Numpy, Pillow e OpenCV).
  • Experiência com extração e análise de banco de dados (SQL).
  • Experiência com limpeza e transformação de dados (Feature Engineering).
  • Experiência com Algoritmos de Regressão, Classificação e Clustering.
  • Experiência com Reinforcement Learning e Association Rules Learning.


Será um Diferencial...

  • Inglês avançado.
  • Mestrado ou Doutorado em Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os ambientes Airflow, Git, Cloud Azure, Pentaho Data Integration.
  • Experiência com MS Fabric, Copilot Studio, Data Factory, Databricks, PowerBI, Kafka, Spark, Spark Streaming.
  • Experiência com ML , DL, AutoML, MLOps e Engenharia de Dados


Atividades:

  • Foco no desenvolvimento de soluções dentro do Lab de Inovação do Cliente.
  • Realizar análises descritivas e exploratórias para entendimento de dados e levantamento de hipóteses técnicas.
  • Desenvolver modelagem preditiva utilizando o estado da arte em Machine Learning e as métricas adequadas para seleção de modelos Validar tecnicamente a utilização dos modelos preditivos.
  • Desenvolver certificação prática do desempenho dos modelos (teste A/B, controle/intervenção, planejamento e experimentos).
  • Colaborar com o time de Estatísticos, Engenheiros em Machine Learning, Economistas para resolver problemas usando Data Science.
  • Validação de estruturas de dados e Feature Engineering.
  • Trabalhar com o time de Engenheiros de Dados e Arquitetos de Dados na criação de Datasets para treinamento de múltiplos modelos.
  • Coletar, limpar, armazenar, organizar, integrar dados e ajudar na criação de pipelines de dados. Auxiliar na expansão do uso da ciência de dados nas frentes dos negócios.

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: SAP PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) - Inglês ou espanhol avançados - 100% home office
description:
Título do cargo: SAP PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)


Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: Disponibilidade para trabalhar em qualquer fuso horário da América Latina (México ou Brasil).


Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Descrição da Vaga:

SAP PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) com experiência em migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA.

Principais Responsabilidades

Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP PLM com experiência comprovada em migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA .

O candidato ideal terá sólido conhecimento em processos e integrações do SAP Product Lifecycle Management , garantindo uma transição perfeita de dados e processos.

A função requer boa comunicação em inglês (nível intermediário ou superior) , além da capacidade de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais em ambientes globais.

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Liderar e apoiar migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA dentro do domínio PLM .
  • Analisar os processos PLM existentes no ECC e projetar soluções otimizadas no S/4.
  • Configurar módulos do SAP PLM , incluindo Document Management System (DMS) , Engineering Change Management (ECM) , Product Structure Management e Recipe/Formulation Management .
  • Garantir a integração entre PLM e outros módulos (MM, PP, SD, QM ).
  • Definir estratégias de migração, mapeamento e regras de transformação.
  • Preparar especificações funcionais e colaborar com as equipes ABAP e Basis para desenvolvimentos customizados.
  • Apoiar as atividades de migração de dados, validações e reconciliações.
  • Executar testes unitários, testes de integração e suporte ao UAT (User Acceptance Test) com usuários-chave.
  • Fornecer suporte funcional e resolver incidentes durante e após a migração.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave.
  • Seguir metodologias SAP (ASAP, Activate, Agile ) para execução de projetos.


Requisitos:

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP PLM .
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração ECC → S/4HANA .
  • Forte conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.
  • Entendimento de gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT ).
  • Inglês avançado e/ou espanhol avançado (oral e escrito).
  • Conhecimento em aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit ).
  • Familiaridade com o SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais .


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.



Como se Candidatar

title: Graphic Designer
